query: best way to get rid of ivy
plausible_answers: Manual pulling with hand tools (snipper, ladder, saw, shovel)
Natural spray: white vinegar OR salt + soap + water solution
Glyphosate (Roundup) or triclopyr (Brush-B-Gon) herbicide applied to leaves
baseline_answer: Natural spray: white vinegar OR salt + soap + water solution
